title: Align committed-evaluation source contracts and logs with the unheld sighting route
outcome: Comments and host diagnostics accurately distinguish holders' committed-input admission from the unheld requester's additional canonical sighting, preserving both admission paths.
acceptance: Committed-flow source comments, naming-token descriptions and host log messages state that the holder route does not read a sighting while the unheld retained-root route does, without altering admission, source capture or authority behavior; no test reads Markdown or pins source comments.
